Chapter 1236: Chapter 1: Tremendous Merit (Subscribe Please)

Golden Mist Treasure Land.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged; this treasure land produced exotic treasures in the form of golden mist.

So it was named ’Golden Mist’.

The treasure lands controlled by the six ancient kingdoms were generally named after the exotic treasures produced there.

For example, the Hei Yu Nest...

is named after ’Hei Yu,’ because the exotic treasure produced there is in the form of Hei Yu.

"Greetings, Galaxy Venerate."

More than a dozen strong warriors from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country entered the Golden Mist Treasure Land and respectfully saluted Lin Yuan.

"Rise."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

The purpose of these Fierce Sun Ancient Country warriors coming here was to establish a space-time teleportation formation within the Golden Mist Treasure Land.

In addition, there was also the defensive formation covering the entire treasure land.

Every treasure land controlled by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is arranged this way.

That is, to establish a space-time teleportation formation connecting the capital, so that support from the capital’s warriors can be timely received in times of crisis.

Although the Golden Mist Treasure Land currently belongs to Lin Yuan, it still technically falls under the jurisdiction of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, so this is permissible.

Lin Yuan accepted this gladly, as with his power, he certainly didn’t worry about any danger befalling the Golden Mist Treasure Land.

But establishing a space-time teleportation formation connecting the capital would make things much more convenient for him.

At the very least, traveling between the two places wouldn’t require spending time on the road.

The Golden Mist Treasure Land is located in a desolate area outside the six ancient kingdoms, at an extremely distant location from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Even Lin Yuan’s speed in controlling space-time would require a considerable amount of time for a round trip.

The space-time teleportation formation would save him from such trouble.

As for setting up the defensive formation that covers the entire treasure land, it would save Lin Yuan a lot of hassle.

"Galaxy Venerate, I’m unsure where to establish the space-time teleportation formation..." a formation master from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country asked softly.

After the treasure land emerges, the space-time it resides in shrinks rapidly, but to what extent it shrinks is only known to the master of the treasure land.

So, the area for establishing the space-time teleportation formation is determined by the master of the treasure land.

This can avoid the situation of establishing the space-time teleportation formation outside the treasure land.

"Anywhere within this range will do."

Lin Yuan condensed a detailed ’map’ of the treasure land, roughly outlining the area.

"Understood."

The numerous warriors comprehended.

Very soon.

Over a dozen formation masters from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country began to busy themselves.

Setting up the space-time teleportation formation was relatively simple, but arranging the defensive formation that covers the entire treasure land required careful planning.

"Space-time teleportation formation..."

Lin Yuan observed for a while, noting that the first task of the dozen formation masters was to establish the space-time teleportation formation, as it was the simplest.

The space-time teleportation formations of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the six ancient kingdoms all follow a unified ’template’, with the spatial crystal stone as the core.

The key lies in the spatial crystal stone.

Every piece of spatial crystal stone is a complete entity.

If divided into two parts, no matter how far apart, they maintain a connection.

The space-time teleportation formation establishes a space-time passage based on this connection, making ultra-long-distance traversal possible.

Of course, the method to lock this connection borrows from techniques left by the Primogenitors.

"Such teleportation methods can only be performed by those special entities in the Chaos Void."

Lin Yuan thought, noting that this source world’s six ancient kingdoms are more ’advanced’ than the Chaos Void in many ways, with Thirteenth Realm techniques commonly seen.

The Thirteenth Realm time-life beings in the Chaos Void are exalted, scarcely affecting sentient beings, with only Great Saints having the drive to track their traces.

But in the six ancient kingdoms? The Thirteenth Realm Primogenitors are right there; joining any ancient country gives one the chance to make contact with a Primogenitor.

Though truly meeting a Primogenitor might be difficult, at least there’s a chance to access the legacy left by them for cultivation.

Like the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram, originating from the Primogenitors.

The Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram representing the Third Realm indeed requires considerable merits.

But the ones representing the First Realm and the Second Realm are relatively affordable.

Great Lord level warriors can generally accumulate the required merits.

...

"These exotic treasures."

Lin Yuan ceased paying attention to the formation masters and began to inventory his gains.

In order to reclaim the profound weaponry of their own ancient countries, except for the Barbaric Wilderness Ancient Country, the four great ancient countries were heavily exploited by Lin Yuan.

Especially the Da Fu Ancient Country, from which Lin Yuan acquired a hundred jins of Dragon Abyss Blood.

Dragon Abyss Blood rarely spreads to the other five ancient kingdoms, held tightly by the Da Fu Ancient Country.

If it weren’t for reclaiming their own profound weaponry, Lin Yuan couldn’t have forced the opponent to voluntarily give up so much Dragon Abyss Blood.

After all, the Da Fu Ancient Country boasts the Da Fu Ancestor, a Thirteenth Realm overseer. Even Lin Yuan, as an Invincible Venerable, can at most make the Da Fu Ancient Country lower its profile, but anything more excessive? That’s impossible.

"I must see why Dragon Abyss Blood is so precious."

Lin Yuan flipped his right hand, and in front of him appeared a jade bottle.

The jade bottle tilted slightly, revealing a single drop so pure that within it, luminous dots intertwined like stars.

This drop of Dragon Abyss Blood was essentially not a mere drop of blood, but a world unto itself, containing numerous operating rules of the grand path.

"Remarkable, truly remarkable."

Lin Yuan observed carefully, genuinely astonished.

To integrate the rules of the grand path into the flesh, making each particle of the body contain a world, resulting in unimaginable power when fully unleashed?

"The first being birthed by this source world?"

Lin Yuan pondered the origins of Dragon Abyss Blood, sensing the formidable power of this primordial existence through the drop of blood.

When each particle that composes the body contains a world? Even if a single world’s power is far less than Lin Yuan’s internal cosmos, the sheer quantity cannot be underestimated!
